Author: Jacob5800
Name: Retainer Pricer
Description: Price eligible retainer listings with live marketboard or Universalis data and a configurable match or one-gil-undercut rule. Manage retainer ventures using the game's own retainer UI.
Punchline: Price listings and manage retainer ventures.
Changelog:
## 0.5.1.93

- New listings now wait and retry up to three times when the game rejects a marketboard request, instead of skipping the item straight away.
- The below-NPC value check now counts market tax, so prices that net no more than selling to the NPC are held for review.
